ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this case is escalated to a human reviewer under POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3). Escalation is terminal — no refund issues, no charge is collected or refunded, and the disputed $10.00 is held.

THE DISTANCE QUESTION CANNOT BE DECIDED ON THIS RECORD. EV-GPS-00110 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): a single 428-second dropout — more than four times the 90-second limb — between the Defu Flyover and Kallang KPE portal fixes, against a 10-second sample interval. The admissibility report records that the gap covers the whole stretch the rider disputes. The trace carries weight 0.39 (issues GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) and it is the only artifact actually carrying the distance: EV-TRIP-00110's actual_distance_km and EV-FARE-00110's distance_charged_km are both copies of the same figure.

POL-RD-01 numbers: actual 21.20 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which governs) against optimal 18.40 km (EV-TRIP-00110), an excess of 2.80 km = 15.2%, below the 20% establishment test. The driver is right that on the driver-favourable straight-line reading POL-RD-07(i) prescribes across the gap, no deviation is established and POL-RD-01 would otherwise produce NO_ACTION. But POL-RD-07(i) fixes how the unobserved stretch is measured; it does not decide whether the driver drove it, and a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km and over the threshold. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two.

Because the trace is impaired, POL-RD-07(ii) bars establishing a deviation on the trace alone and requires an independent source. None exists: the chat log holds no driver admission (and is itself impaired at 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG, ending 2186 s before trip end); the fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null (and is impaired at 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD); the driver's counterparty statement says only that he took the KPE — the optimal corridor — and so admits no detour; and the trip record's actual_distance_km is itself derived from the impaired trace. POL-RD-07(iii) is explicit that in this situation the claim is not sustained but the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory on the same facts.

Independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact — EV-GPS-00110 at 0.39 (the chat and fare artifacts carry no independent distance fact, and the counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier) — which is below the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) would also require escalation. The bundle's mean weight is not the cap.

CLAIMS ANSWERED: (1) The driver's POL-RD-01 threshold point (2.80 km / 15.2%) is accepted as arithmetic but does not end the case: POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10 govern an impaired trace and displace NO_ACTION. (2) The driver's point that nothing shows the vehicle leaving the optimal corridor, citing the message 'going KPE ah boss' and the statement 'I took the KPE like always', is accepted as far as it goes — but the chat is truncated at 18:26:14, roughly 36 minutes before trip end, the statement carries no weight, and neither evidence covers the impaired stretch. (3) The rider's timing point (39 min against the 26.0 min optimal) is noted but is not a POL-RD-01 limb, which is a distance test; it neither establishes nor defeats a deviation. (4) The driver's POL-RD-06 point is accepted: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 744, so no pattern is established and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. (5) The driver's ERP point is accepted: EV-TRIP-00110 records optimal_route_erp_sgd 3.00 for the KPE/ECP route crossing both gantries and the ledger charges tolls_erp 3.00 at metered cost with surge 1.0; the itemisation is absent rather than contradicted, so POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged and no billing-integrity referral arises. (6) The rider's point that no traffic advisory exists is accepted — EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so POL-RD-03 exonerates nothing — but it supplies no corroboration either. (7) The rider's point that no independent source corroborates a deviation is accepted, and is the ground of the escalation. (8) The rider's POL-GEN-02 cap point is accepted, as set out above. For completeness, had a deviation been established, POL-RD-02 on EV-FARE-00110 would give charged_total $34.42, recomputed_fare $25.68 and a refund of $8.75; escalation is terminal and no such amount issues.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT: a clean GPS trace covering the KPE stretch, an itemised ERP gantry record placing the vehicle on or off the optimal corridor, or a route map showing the path actually driven.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
